tasks.short: Service and adjust farm machinery, repair breakdowns in the field, notify the supervisor of malfunctions, and record the service done.

steps.what: Farm equipment operator services and adjusts farm machinery
Farm equipment operator repairs machinery breakdowns in the field
Farm equipment operator notifies supervisors by phone when machinery malfunctions
Farm equipment operator records the service done in a paper logbook

tasks.design: Malfunctions are reported in the farm app ({OPS_SYSTEM}) with a photo and the machine picked from a list, and the supervisor gets a notification, so most reports no longer need a call. Service is logged on the machine's record in the app, with engine hours read from the machine's own data, instead of a paper logbook. Servicing, adjusting and repairing stay with the operator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Faults were phoned through and service written in a paper logbook.
tasks.enabler_now: Farm apps log machine service and send notifications; machine data can be read.
tasks.still_hard: Urgent breakdowns at harvest still need a call.
tasks.human_edge: Hearing a bearing that is about to fail.

evidence.claim: Farm apps can log machine service and send fault notifications.
Users of connected farm machines may access the data they generate and share it with third parties.

assumptions: Boundary: from the machine due to the service recorded; dealer repairs are outside.
Input contract: machines in the app; fallback is phone and logbook.
Service and repair work do not change.
Supervisors read notifications as they took calls.
research_questions: Do repeat breakdowns fall with a full service history?

incremental.description: Farm equipment operator adds machines and service intervals to the app.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few faults; high: large fleets with frequent service.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assign crew tasks and fields, direct and monitor crews in the field, and record hours and fields worked per crew member.

steps.what: Farm equipment operator assigns crew tasks and fields at the start of the day
Farm equipment operator directs and monitors work crews engaged in planting, weeding or harvesting
Farm equipment operator records hours and fields worked per crew member on paper

tasks.design: Hours and fields are recorded in the farm app ({OPS_SYSTEM}) by ticking the crew list and the field on the map, with times defaulting to the day's plan, so they are not written on paper and typed in by the office. Assigning tasks and directing crews stay with the operator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hours were written on paper per crew member.
tasks.enabler_now: Farm apps record crew hours per field.
tasks.still_hard: Crews that move between fields during the day need corrections.
tasks.human_edge: Keeping a tired crew safe and working well on a hot day.

evidence.claim: Farm apps can record crew hours per field.
Logging work per worker monitors attendance, behaviour or performance and needs works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: from the day's work to hours recorded; pay is outside.
Input contract: crew lists in the app; fallback is paper.
Works council consent comes before use.

incremental.description: Farm equipment operator corrects hours for crews that moved fields.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: small crews; high: large seasonal crews.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Weigh crop-filled containers, write weights with field, crop and picker on a sheet, type the sheets into the farm records, and label the containers.

steps.what: Farm equipment operator weighs crop-filled containers
Farm equipment operator records weights and other identifying information on a paper sheet
Farm equipment operator types the weigh sheets into the farm records spreadsheet
Farm equipment operator labels containers by hand

tasks.design: The scale is linked to the farm records app on a phone ({OPS_SYSTEM}): the operator picks field and crop once, and each weight is captured from the scale with the time, so nothing is written on a sheet or typed in later. The app prints a label with weight, field and lot code for each container. Weighing stays with the operator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Weights were written on paper sheets and typed in later.
tasks.enabler_now: Farm apps log harvest in the field and link to scales.
tasks.still_hard: Older scales have no data link.
tasks.human_edge: Spotting a container with damaged produce before it is weighed in.

reach.learn: Whether yields per field are current.

evidence.claim: AgroVision Crops logs sowing, spraying, fertilising and harvest on a phone in the field.
Logging harvest per worker monitors performance and needs works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: from containers filled to containers labelled; sales are outside.
Input contract: scale with a data link; fallback is paper sheets.
Works council consent comes before weights are tied to pickers.
research_questions: Do yield figures per field become available the same day?

incremental.description: Farm equipment operator corrects mis-picked fields in the app.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: older scales; high: linked scales and label printers.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The farm equipment operator keeps servicing machines, directing crews and weighing crops; phone reports, paper logbooks and weigh sheets shrink.
role.ambitious_version: An operator with more time in the field.
